identity: Hearthpine cuts the pit props for the Copperfell shafts; this year the woods bite back, and a gang of ore thieves under a chief called Bracket is carting off what the shift digs.

quests.title: Tusks in the Timber
quests.text: Small Boars are rooting through the cut timber {zone_area:timberline} by day. Bring down eight of them; a yellow name means the beast only fights once you start it. Someone has been stealing our ore as well, but first the pigs.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls; keep the meat.

quests.title: A Dwarf Without a Pick
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and show them to me here in Hearthpine. I keep the pair for the timber crew and hand you a fresh one; nobody in this hall goes out with bare hands.
quests.lesson: Grid crafting of the first tools; turned-in tools are replaced.

quests.title: Wood for the Smokehouse
quests.text: The smokehouse eats logs faster than the timber crew eats sausages. Bring me five logs from any tree outside the town, whatever the hour.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not; protected town trees cannot be cut.

quests.title: Rats on the Night Shift
quests.text: After dark Large Rats take over the same timber {zone_area:timberline}. Kill eight there; a red name attacks on sight, and one rat squeals for its cousins, so keep your back to a stump.
quests.lesson: Night clock and red names; rats call nearby rats.

quests.title: Stone Before Steel
quests.text: Use the wooden pick on plain rock outside the walls and make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring both for inspection; I return a pair for the ore work ahead.
quests.lesson: Pick tiers gate rock; stone tools open the next rock.

quests.title: Coal for the Oven
quests.text: Bring me five Coal Lumps from the rock outside town, whenever the hunt leaves you a moment. Coal goes in the fuel slot, raw food in the cooking slot, and dwarves go to the table.
quests.lesson: Gathering while waiting for night; the public oven stands in town.

quests.title: Patches for the Flour Sacks
quests.text: The rats chewed my flour sacks, so the rats can mend them. Bring two Rat Fur Patches from the Large Rats in the {name:timberline} after nightfall.
quests.lesson: Ordinary family loot answers a pantry request.

quests.title: Lanterns After Sundown
quests.text: When the sun is down, Braindead Zombies crawl up off the {name:shingle} {dir_from_giver:shingle}. Put eight of them back down. They burn at dawn, so this is night work; do the daytime jobs while you wait.
quests.lesson: Zombies come at night and burn in the sun.

quests.title: The High Path
quests.text: Young Ibex kick loose slate onto the path through the {name:high_pines} {zone_area:high_pines}. Thin out eight of them by day, before the slate thins out a dwarf.
quests.lesson: A daytime hunt beside the night work; ibex are neutral grazers.

quests.title: The Winter Smoke
quests.text: Bring me ten Raw Meat for the winter racks: boar by day, rat by night, ibex if you can catch one. Keep what you already carry; it all smokes the same. Take some cooked meat back for the road.
quests.lesson: Earlier hunting loot pays a later request.

quests.title: Two Metals, One Furnace
quests.text: Smelt three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars from the local ore and bring them to me. The shaft props need fittings, and you will get a portable dual furnace for your trouble. Set it outside protected ground.
quests.lesson: Ore to bar; a dual furnace takes two inputs.

quests.title: Crab for the Feast Table
quests.text: Bring me three Crab Legs from the crabs of the {name:rockpools} {dir_from_giver:rockpools}. The small ones mind their own business; the monstrous ones do not, so mind yours.
quests.lesson: Shore strips by day; neutral and aggressive crabs share the rocks.

quests.title: Bronze for the Road
quests.text: Make three fresh Bronze Bars in your dual furnace and bring them here. The earlier bars went into the props, so do not count them twice. Take this bronze pick; it bites rock the stone one only scratches.
quests.lesson: Alloys need fresh inputs; the Bronze Pickaxe is the onward tool.

quests.title: Bracket's Ledger of Theft
quests.text: The ore thieves sit in the {name:ore_thief_camp} {dir_from_giver:ore_thief_camp}, day and night. Defeat seven Confused Ore Thieves, then deal with their chief, Bracket, who keeps the stolen ore in a ledger nobody else can read. Pull him away from his crew if you can.
quests.lesson: Seven helpers and one normal named leader; pull the chief alone.

quests.title: Word for Orrik Pineledger
quests.text: Bracket's crew carted the ore off toward Copperfell. Take word to Orrik Pineledger in Copperfell Village along the main road; the foothills are your work now. Finish what you like here first.
quests.lesson: Start to home zone handoff at level 9 to 10.
